question: As language models grew, some skills seemed to appear suddenly at a certain size. What did a 2023 study mainly blame?
options: A size at which reasoning switches on
Test answers leaking into training text
answer: All-or-nothing scoring. If a model must get all 5 digits of an answer right, and its accuracy per digit climbs steadily from 50% to 90%, its score leaps from 3% to 59%. Given partial credit, the same models improved smoothly. The jump was in the ruler, not in the model.
move: A score that needs every step right turns steady progress into a sudden leap.
trap: Reading a sharp jump in scores as a sharp change in ability.
reference: Schaeffer, Miranda & Koyejo, Are Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models a Mirage?, NeurIPS, 2023
